name: Carousel
description: A motorized carousel with five transition effects (tilt, slide, scale, fade and cube), momentum dragging, autoplay with a progress bar and seamless loop — for text, images or any other content.
interactionNotes: Drag the cards and release: your finger's speed is measured and the card springs onto the nearest slide. The horizontal mouse wheel also turns the page, and the arrows/dots/bars give a direct jump. In RTL the engine is mirrored: "next" comes from the left and the strip of cards follows your finger. The keys are logical: the right arrow is always "next".

props.name: items
props.description: The cards; a string (image URL), a CarouselItem object, or any custom ReactElement.

props.name: baseWidth
props.description: Maximum width of the carousel, pixels.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Width-to-height ratio of the card; 0.5 to 4. Use 0.62 for a vertical story.

props.name: peek
props.description: How much of the neighboring card is visible from the edge, pixels.

props.name: gap
props.description: Spacing between the cards, pixels.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the cards.

props.name: frame
props.description: Glass frame around the carousel.

props.name: effect
props.description: Transition effect between the cards; cube needs 3D perspective and shadow and provides them itself.

props.name: indicator
props.description: Indicator shape; with autoplay, bars fill so you know when the next one is.

props.name: arrows
props.description: Previous/next arrow buttons — they mirror themselves in RTL.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Autoplay; it stops on hover (if pauseOnHover), focus, dragging, or when the tab is hidden.

props.name: autoplayDelay
props.description: Autoplay interval, milliseconds (minimum 600).

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Holding the pointer over the carousel pauses the playing.

props.name: loop
props.description: Seamless loop: go from the last card to the first.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Dragging with pointer/touch and the horizontal mouse wheel.

props.name: round
props.description: Full-height round card — for avatars and badges.

props.name: initialIndex
props.description: The first slide.

props.name: theme
props.description: Palette of the frame and the controls; it can also be changed from outside with `--carousel-*` variables.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called on every arrival at a new slide.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class for the root.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style of the root.

tips: The engine mirrors in RTL, not just the look: translations and the cube angle flip with the sign of the X axis, dragging follows your finger and throw velocity advances correctly — the sign is gathered in one place in `settings.sign`.
The mouse wheel deliberately doesn't take the mirror sign: a positive deltaX means "going forward" in both directions — the same natural feel as scrolling.
For a gallery row with a half-visible neighbor: `frame={false}` + `peek={64}` + `effect="scale"` — the blurred edge mask builds itself.
Pair autoplay with the bar indicator (`indicator="bars"`) so the user understands how many seconds are left to the next slide — the stories pattern.
The round card (`round`) squares the width to the image ratio; for short text inside it, `compact` applies automatically and the description is hidden.
